categories.main_business_segments: Qingdao Haier Biomedical Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two segments: Life Sciences and Medical Innovation. The Life Sciences segment serves research institutions and pharmaceutical companies with products like smart laboratories, biobanks, cell culture workstations, and laboratory consumables. The Medical Innovation segment targets hospitals, public health, and blood/plasma stations, offering solutions such as automated medication dispensing, vaccine cold chain management, and blood management systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced low-temperature refrigeration technologies, automation, AI, IoT, cloud computing, and big data analytics. Key proprietary technologies include Stirling refrigeration, ultra-low temperature storage, AI-driven sample management, automated liquid handling robots, and precision temperature and humidity control. Production follows a make-to-order model with multiple specialized production lines and subsidiaries focusing on different product categories.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Customers include pharmaceutical and biotech companies, universities, research institutes, hospitals, public health agencies, blood and plasma collection centers, and international organizations. The company serves both domestic Chinese markets and over 150 countries globally, with significant presence in the US, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and emerging markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and production facilities in Qingdao and subsidiaries across major Chinese cities. It has a broad international footprint with sales and service networks in over 150 countries, including localized teams in the US, UK, Netherlands, Singapore, India, and others. It maintains overseas warehouses and logistics centers to support global operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Haier Biomedical operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the biomedical supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and selling biomedical equipment, consumables, and integrated digital solutions. It controls R&D, production, sales, and after-sales service, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider rather than a raw material supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology leadership through open and diversified R&D platforms, focusing on low-temperature refrigeration, automation, digitalization, and AI integration. It prioritizes expanding product lines in life sciences and medical innovation, developing smart laboratories, automated medication systems, and digital public health platforms. Strategic priorities include accelerating global market penetration, enhancing user experience via digital transformation, and pursuing synergistic acquisitions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of medical devices, laboratory equipment, consumables, and integrated digital solutions. The company also earns income from installation services, software maintenance contracts, and leasing of specialized equipment. Sales are conducted mainly via distributors with a growing direct sales component, especially for institutional and international clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Haier Biomedical is a leading domestic player and ranks among the top three globally in biomedical low-temperature storage. It holds dominant market shares in China for ultra-low temperature freezers, liquid nitrogen tanks, and medical refrigerators. The company differentiates itself through technological innovation, comprehensive digital solutions, and extensive global networks, competing with international and local biomedical equipment manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 2.28 billion, showing a slight growth of 0.13% year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 366.6 million, a decrease of 9.71% mainly due to non-operating factors. The company maintains a strong R&D investment ratio of over 13% of revenue and has a stable asset base with total assets around RMB 5.79 billion, reflecting steady growth and financial health.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Haier Biomedical emphasizes delivering best-in-class user experience through innovative, integrated digital solutions that combine hardware, software, and services. Its products feature industry-leading energy efficiency, precision control, and automation capabilities. The company’s unique value lies in its comprehensive smart biomedical ecosystem, global localized service, and continuous innovation that addresses evolving customer needs in life sciences and healthcare.
